cv: nested run-grouped OOF; calibration fitted on inner OOF of each outer training pool

policy_selection.criterion: fewest mean sequences at no pooled fused stopped-accuracy loss versus default; ties prefer higher accuracy then ITR

scoring_core.sequence_policy: per-flash logits aggregated into row/column softmax, posterior products accumulated until locked threshold/min/max
scoring_core.itr: variable-time ITR using 2.0 seconds per complete 17-flash OOF sequence
